answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 5830 Country: AU Title: I am pregnant and my due date is 13th june. Ramadan fasts are starting from august. My child will be too small and will depend on my breast milk. Is it compulsory for me to fast during those days, can I keep these fasts later. Question: I am pregnant and my due date is 13th june. Ramadan fasts are starting from august. My child will be too small and will depend on my breast milk. Is it compulsory for me to fast during those days, can I keep these fasts later. Answer ID: 5830 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1334/1164=B-1429) If due to keeping fast during the month of Ramadan, you fear about your life or your child's life though on ground of probability or by prescription of an expert Muslim doctor, then in such case you are exempted from keeping fast. Later, it is necessary for you to do its qaza . But, if there is no threat on life, then it is obligatory to keep fast. Thus, if your husband is rich and can have wet-nurse for breastfeeding the child, then you must not abandon keeping fast. However, if the child does not take milk of anyone except his own mother, then it is right form the mother not to keep fast, she should do qaza later. وفی الدر المختار: أو حامل أو مرضع أماًّ كانت أو ظئرا وفي الشاميه: أما الظئر فلأن الإرضاع واجب عليها بالعقد و أما الأم فلوجوبه ديانة مطلقا و قضاء إذا كان الأب معسرا الخ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
